sourceEvidence.statement: Frozen Ubuntu 22.04 CI selects Node 22 and separately installs dependencies, copies .env, migrates and generates Prisma, conditionally seeds, and builds.
Frozen root npm lockfile is bound for deterministic npm ci preparation.
Manifest requires Node 22 and defines build, Prisma migration and generation, Playwright download, and Prisma seed behavior without an exact npm pin.
